messages:
emilia_ops: big thanks on the infra update today 
emilia_ops: couple quick clarifications so I can update the weekly briefing: 1) precise GPU SKUs were expecting across Hosted/Dedicated, 2) what customers should expect in terms of p99 during short burst windows when warm pools are exhausted

rafael_infra: short answer: Dedicated = H100/A100 primarily; Hosted high-tier uses the same plus some H100-backed high-concurrency clusters. We intentionally keep a pool of T4/RTX-class nodes for low-cost embedding and autoscale fallbacks. Shipments are arriving in two waves over the next 4-6 weeks, NA then EU, APAC follows subject to partner scheduling.

tara_sre: on latency: warm pools (per-AZ) will handle the common case. Default min_warm_instances will be small (1-3) and auto-scaled by traffic pattern. If warm pools are exhausted, the autoscaler first tries preemptible local capacity, then model-variant fallback (quantized/smaller model) before cross-region routing. Expect p99 to be stable for typical spikes; for pathological bursts ( >8x sustained ) customers may see elevated p99 until fallback routing completes.

ben_product: can we get a short FAQ snippet to put in the console and the signup flow? need something 1-2 lines for the reservation modal and a brief note for AEs.

rafael_infra: yes. Draft FAQ were planning: "Region availability: NA prioritized, EU next, APAC pilot. GPUs: H100/A100 for high-throughput; T4/RTX for embeddings and low-cost fallbacks. Autoscale: warm pools + preemptible burst; extreme spikes may fallback to quantized variants. Reserve to lock ETA."

infra-bot: [deploy] autoscaler-v2 canary scheduled: 2026-11-12T02:00Z -> target 10% Dedicated clusters. Watch: autoscale_events, cold_start_rate, p99_latency.

tara_sre: ops note: teams wanting to test behavior can use this sample policy when simulating: ```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_warm_instances: 2
  fallback_model_preference: [quantized, smaller]
  preemptible_burst_pct: 20
  cold_start_grace_ms: 150
```

emilia_ops: great, two ops questions: will committed Reserved capacity be prioritized into warm pools? and will cross-region backfill be opt-in?

rafael_infra: yes to both. Reserved commits get allocation priority and a warm pool reservation in the chosen region. Cross-region backfill is opt-in (checkbox during reservation/signup) and documented with a latency warning; fallback model routing is preferred for latency SLAs.

ben_product: pricing question: any changes to committed pricing or burst metering?

rafael_infra: committed pricing unchanged. Burst/preemptible usage billed separately (burst rates). Were adding a simple estimator in the console that shows likely burst costs based on the last 30 days of traffic.

maya_ceo: request: infra + product to publish (1) short public FAQ for the signup modal and status page, (2) internal one-pager for Sales/AEs, (3) support brief. Target EOD Thursday. Keep APAC wording conservative.

rafael_infra: will share drafts by Thursday EOD and post here.

tara_sre: operational safety: creating a paging rule for rollouts: cold_start_rate > 5% for 10m -> page SRE. Also will run a 3x spike smoke test during canary and rollback if cold_start_rate threshold breached.

infra-bot: [alert] paging rule created: cold_start_rate > 5% for 10m -> page oncall SRE.

emilia_ops: perfect 
emilia_ops: once FAQ is up Ill update the all-hands digest and notify AEs. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
